package generated

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"sync"

	machine "github.com/whitaker-io/machine/v4"
)

// The Go a .flow author writes beside their source. It is NOT generated; it
// stands in for the package the flow's references resolve into, so the golden
// file can be compiled AND RUN rather than only diffed.
//
// WHY THIS FIXTURE CARRIES MORE THAN THE OTHERS. `switch` is the one construct
// in this module that no fixture executed: it appears in this .flow alone, and
// the golden set only ever compiled it. A switch that lowers to the wrong arm
// targets compiles perfectly, so the sinks here print a token naming WHICH SINK
// a datum reached, and the refundable arm's predicate records its own answer.

type Order struct {
	ID   string
	Kind string
}

type Receipt struct{ ID string }

func Poll() machine.EdgeFactory[Order] { return machine.Channel[Order](0) }

// expectedArrivals is how many data a host pushes to exercise every arm: one
// down the value-match arm, one down the predicate arm, one down else.
const expectedArrivals = 3

var (
	routeMu sync.Mutex
	// routeVerdict records, per datum, what the refundable arm's predicate
	// ANSWERED. It is the only observable that separates the refundable arm from
	// the else arm, because the flow routes both into the same sink.
	routeVerdict = map[string]bool{}
	routeArrived int
	routeDone    = make(chan struct{})
	routeOnce    sync.Once
)

// Done reports when every pushed datum has reached a sink, so a host exits on
// the data rather than on a timer.
func Done() <-chan struct{} { return routeDone }

// IsRefund is the refundable arm's predicate.
//
// RECORDING ITS ANSWER IS WHAT MAKES THE ELSE ARM OBSERVABLE. A datum reaches
// the else arm precisely when this returns false for it, and it is consulted
// only for data the value-match arm did not already claim — so a datum with no
// recorded verdict took the first arm, one recorded true took the refundable
// arm, and one recorded false fell through to else. The sink the last two share
// cannot tell them apart on its own.
func IsRefund(o Order) bool {
	refund := o.Kind == "refund"

	routeMu.Lock()
	routeVerdict[o.ID] = refund
	routeMu.Unlock()

	return refund
}

func Bill(f machine.Frame[Order]) Order { return f.Value() }

func Succeeded(f machine.Frame[Order]) bool { return f.Value().ID != "" }

// Store is the sink the VALUE-MATCH arm reaches, through the charge transform
// and the settle branch.
func Store(f machine.Frame[Order]) Order {
	v := f.Value()
	arrived("store", v, false)

	return v
}

// Quarantine is the sink the refundable and else arms converge on. Its token
// carries the recorded predicate answer, which is what names the arm.
func Quarantine(f machine.Frame[Order]) Order {
	v := f.Value()
	arrived("hold", v, true)

	return v
}

// arrived prints one locked token and releases the host once every pushed datum
// has landed.
//
// THE LOCK IS NOT DECORATION. The runtime dispatches every datum as its own
// goroutine, so without it two tokens interleave on stdout and the arrival count
// loses increments — the same defect class this fixture set was just repaired
// for, in its package-level form.
func arrived(sink string, o Order, withVerdict bool) {
	routeMu.Lock()
	defer routeMu.Unlock()

	if withVerdict {
		refund, evaluated := routeVerdict[o.ID]
		fmt.Printf("flow-routing: sink=%s id=%s kind=%s refund=%t evaluated=%t\n",
			sink, o.ID, o.Kind, refund, evaluated)
	} else {
		fmt.Printf("flow-routing: sink=%s id=%s kind=%s\n", sink, o.ID, o.Kind)
	}

	routeArrived++
	if routeArrived >= expectedArrivals {
		routeOnce.Do(func() { close(routeDone) })
	}
}

// ReportFailure is the error handler a HOST installs with
// machine.OptionErrorHandler.
//
// THIS FLOW DECLARES NO `on error` CLAUSE, so unlike the pipeline golden there
// is no generated handler var for a host to pass; it supplies this one directly.
// Without it the runtime's guard recovers a node panic, dispatch finds neither a
// per-node nor a global handler and drops it, and any failure in here presents
// as a program that simply never finishes.
func ReportFailure(err machine.NodeError[any]) {
	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "flow-routing: handler: node=%s panic=%t err=%v\n",
		err.Node, err.Panic, err.Err)
}
